content:wysiwyg_basic:1789499747863:0.32.html:

Ring in the holiday season and sprad cheer to the community by bell ringing with The Salvation Army! Your friendly smile, warm greeting, and willingness to ring the bell can help provide hope and essential support to neighbors in need.

content:wysiwyg_basic:1789499747863:0.32.html:
Center of Hope 

Make a difference in the lives of women and children, staying at the Center of Hope. Your time and compassion can make a meaningful difference to women and children experiencing homelessness. Our shelter welcomes caring volunteers who want to serve, encourage, and support families as they work toward stability and a brighter future.

Volunteer at the Center of Hope

content:wysiwyg_basic:1789499747863:0.32.name: WYSIWYG
content:wysiwyg_basic:1789499747863:0.32.html:
Red Shield Youth Centers 

Help local youth learn, grow, and have fun! Volunteers at our youth center provide positive support and meaningful experiences that help young people build confidence and reach their potential. This is your opportunity help with homework, lead or assist with recreational activities, and be a positive role model and encouraging presence.

Volunteer at the Youth Centers

content:wysiwyg_basic:1789499747863:0.32.html:
Impact Drives and Various Activities

Provide essential needs like snack packs, household supplies, and other basic necessities. Assist with approved activities and tasks that help create a safe, clean, and comfortable environment for students and residents. Offer encouragement, kindness, and a welcoming presence to those staying at the Center of Hope, or attending one of our Red Shield Youth Centers.

Impact Drive Opportunities

content:wysiwyg_basic:1789055736070:0.58.name: WYSIWYG
content:wysiwyg_basic:1789055736070:0.58.html:
Center of Hope Meal Service: Providing nourishment and comfort to individuals and families experiencing homelessness.

Adopt a Meal Program: This program provides a much-needed meal to the women and children at our Center of Hope Homeless Shelter. Organizations, church groups, corporate teams, and individuals are needed to provide meals for the families staying with us. 

Group Opportunities: We can accommodate your group’s desire to do something good together – whether family, friends, coworkers, civic or church groups. 

Other Group and Individual Volunteer Opportunities:

  • Acceptable Donations for the Center of Hope
  • Welcome Home Baskets
  • Dignity Drive for new underwear
  • Hope Bundles
  • Linen and Bedding Drive
  • Snack Pack Program
  • Teen Project Instructions
